answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 63776 Country: India Title: Reciting Durood e Shareef Question: We all family members gather once a while on a holiday and before having our lunch, we all sit with children and recite durood shareef. A member of our family had arrived from abroad and did not attend the family gathering with a note that instead of reciting durood e shareef it would be better to read Quran e Majeed with its meaning. Please reply if our family member who did not attend has a fair stand? Answer ID: 63776 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 501/501/B=06/1437) Both the opinions are right; first recite durood and then recite the Holy Quran with authentic translation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
